# Fourward

> Fourward is one senior marketing team for B2B SaaS companies. It leads search, content and AI visibility (SEO, GEO and AEO), brand, PR and partnerships, lifecycle and demand generation, and field marketing and events, on one plan.

Fourward works with B2B SaaS teams as a monthly marketing partnership or a fixed-scope project. Every engagement starts with a call and a free SEO, AEO and GEO audit, followed by a written plan with the price within three working days.

Fourward was founded in 2026 by Sharang Misri, Deepak Sharma, Geetanjali Sharma and Rishabh Gautam, and is based in India. More: [What is Fourward?](https://www.fourwardhq.com/blog/what-is-fourward/)

## Free tools

- [AI visibility check](https://www.fourwardhq.com/tools/ai-visibility-check/): 30 checks on what Google, ChatGPT and Perplexity can read about a website, with one score out of 100.
- [AI crawler checker](https://www.fourwardhq.com/tools/ai-crawler-checker/): shows which of 20 AI crawlers can read a website, from robots.txt rules to firewall access, plus llms.txt and sitemap checks.

## Services

- [B2B SaaS marketing](https://www.fourwardhq.com/b2b-saas-marketing/): the service page: one senior team for search and AI visibility, brand and PR, lifecycle and events, how engagements start, ways to work and FAQs.
- [What we do](https://www.fourwardhq.com/#services): search, content and AI visibility; brand, PR and partnerships; lifecycle and demand generation; field marketing and events.
- [Process](https://www.fourwardhq.com/#process): discovery call, free audit, written plan, kickoff.
- [Ways to work](https://www.fourwardhq.com/#ways): free audit and session, monthly marketing partnership, fixed-scope project.

## Case studies

- [BootcampGuide](https://www.fourwardhq.com/case-studies/bootcampguide/): our own bootcamp comparison site; top Google result for five comparison searches, cited in seven Google AI Overviews, 20 leads in its first month (checked 21 October 2026).

- [Best B2B SaaS marketing agencies in 2026](https://www.fourwardhq.com/blog/best-b2b-saas-marketing-agencies/): fourteen agencies compared on services, published pricing, client results and fit.
- [Best GEO agencies in 2026](https://www.fourwardhq.com/blog/best-geo-agencies/): twelve agencies compared on their AI search work, pricing and proof, plus a crawler check of each agency's own site.
